_comment: DWM3001CDK UWB Two-Way Ranging (TWR) Demo Configuration
_info: Requires two DWM3001CDK units. Flash TWR demo firmware from Qorvo SDK.
_flash_instructions: 3. Flash initiator: nrfjprog --program twr_initiator.hex -f NRF52 --sectorerase && nrfjprog --reset -f NRF52
4. Flash responder: repeat step 3 on second unit with twr_responder.hex
5. Connect both units and monitor serial output for distance readings
